en: This is a historical postcard. The front side displays a black-and-white photograph of a well-dressed woman and a young man. The woman is wearing a luxurious fur stole and a large fashionable hat, typical of high society in the early 20th century. The background features a grand building with arched windows. The caption at the top reads: 'Prinzessin Helene und Prinz Georg Wilhelm zu Waldeck u. Pyrmont.' The reverse side contains postal formatting, a logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and printed text indicating the card was produced by Hof-Kunstanstalt Carl Thoericht, Hann. Münden, with additional German text and some handwritten notes.
